content.summary: The strongest assurance words retain meaningful local qualifiers. In particular, retaining 155 A1K source files is not presented as rebuilding all 155: the methods name 100 inherited plus 14 new modules. The scan claim remains confined to its audited scope. No material editorial overstatement emerged from this focused challenge; frozen and evidence hashes match.

checks.scope: Absolute assurance language and source-scope boundaries
checks.method: Read complete/all/only/independent/checked wording against F22's lexical-scan scope and F29's composite rebuild summary.
checks.observation: F22 covers 114 protected modules and explicitly lacks elaboration or axiom-closure checking; the manuscript attributes axiom conclusions separately. F29 records 100+14 rebuilt modules, 66 audited roots, and cached Lean/mathlib dependencies. Complete refers to support/reduction assemblies, while finite exclusion remains outstanding. Independent reproduction and organizational independence are explicitly disclaimed; the smaller independent target describes a proposed proof route.
